reviews.title: Oh how I wish I knew about this growing up
reviews.text:
The first time I had a reading done was strange in itself. 
 Strange because I wasn’t looking to have one done but a series of events that were strange in itself lead me to someone who had never seen or heard of me before and was not really interested in meeting them but somehow I ended up in his town by missing my interchange on the freeway. Next thing I know I’m in his town. I know this because of the car that he gave me said Orville and the sign on the freeway said welcome to Orville completely out of my way by at least a half hour. I decided well I guess maybe I’m supposed to go visit with this guy so I did and three hours later as I go to leave is when he calls me back to his apartment and I ask him did I forget something and he says no, but they are telling me that you need a reading done or want one done and I was like they were they so it doesn’t matter just go ahead and drive and I will text it to you. He did and when it came through, it was so powerful. I had to pull off the road because I was crying so hard I almost crashed. The accuracy was incredible. He also gave me some insights on my past present in future, and it was literally happening in real time things he said had already happened things that he said were already in play and the thing that he said was going to happen happened. These people are incredible. This person was not from this site, but amazing and incredible to his website is called into a light. He can find it on Facebook. Thank you to all you amazing people. If you don’t believe try it you will then.

reviews.title: Anna
reviews.text: Crazy accurate!!! I am not sure who writes these or how they come up with them but it's almost crazy how accurate they are sometimes!! I'm usually not one of those swear by astrology sign type of people but this app really describes what I am going through most of the time and it gives you positive hope. And I even once had an appointment with an astrologer who was supposed to help me solve some of my personal issues, and that was of course a different experience. But for those who haven’t seen real astrologers, this app is the closest to it I’ve ever seen And I can tell you for sure that with the help of the stars you can find out the most important numbers in your life, which tattoo should people of your sign do, when is the best moon for a new haircut, and a lot more. And this app is great about it, it gives you so many tips from different parts of your life, that with the personal astrologer you’d have to pay a fortune for that! So this app ain’t be cheap, but the price for this detailed info is more than acceptable. But that’s only for people who care about real astrology, for those who should just read some random predictions, framed as your horoscope - go on with free apps. I don’t believe there would be people doing so much work to prepare horoscopes for free. So I definitely recommend this app to anyone I know who is at least a bit interested in astrology, thank you for making this app so great!

reviews.title: Curious if I recently met my soulmate
reviews.text:
Four weeks ago I first started talking to this hot younger guy that I’ve been admiring that I’ve also assumed was straight who I had maybe a 1% chance of ever being friends with and a basically 0% chance of ever getting with sexually. Then the unthinkable happened, we found out we have so much in common. He does like girls but I can’t figure out if he’s also in to men. His texts and conversations lead me to suspect he might really be into me as more than a friend or even a best friend. I’m so excited because as a 47 year old gay men who’s never been in a serious relationship that has pretty much accepted the fact that I will likely die a lonely old man, I am just so excited about this.  He seems such an unlikely catch, he’s 20 years younger than me and incredibly sexy. His body language around me is quite awkward but I feel like this is because he is probably not comfortable yet with his sexuality.  I’m scared to make a move and risk our friendship if this isn’t how he actually feels so I’m just going to be cautious and let him reveal himself to me on his own terms. He definitely knows I’m gay but he never has brought  it up. 

I got a reading and the psychic confirmed what I suspected and he will eventually fall in love with me. Of course, I don’t know for certain this reading will play out accurately but I’d like to think so.

reviews.title: Good for daily horoscope, but readings feel rooted in greed.
reviews.text: This app is very well made, and it is great for the daily horoscope and other information like your birth charts and much more information about you. However, I feel as if the prices for the readings are rooted in greed, and the paywall would be best for those making $100,000 per year or more. You get 3 minutes for free then every minute is 30-60 pts. 10 points is the equivalent of $1. So a ten minute conversation by text will cost you roughly $30. Not to mention the reading people will be on and off the conversation sometimes so you are occasionally paying while they are talking to someone else. This is definitely a critical issue. They need to rearrange the app to where you can schedule a 15ish minute reading for a reasonable price and have the reader exclusively. Some readers go up to 60 pts or $6 dollars a minute. I have local readings at a place that charges about $70 for 30 minutes. So I certainly feel like the prices on the app are quite excessive in my opinion. They are also basically sales people as random readers text me in the app every day to chat with them for money per minute. Decent app but a minute goes by instantly and it can take 2 minutes for them to even respond or look at your question.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
There’s not much to it unless you pay for the subscription which is more than 100 annually. It’s not worth it. The only thing it really has to offer is the pretty graphics it provides and the fact that it’s easily accessible since it’s an app. But for the most part it’s straight up a gimmick and basic info you can get for free. Do the 3 day trial and see for yourself. You’ll be paying over $100 for an app you’ll either get bored of quickly or won’t really benefit from very much. You can get a detailed horoscope reading and natal charts from many websites online for free or for way way cheaper. Save your money. Note: I read many of the comments/reviews for the app and the developer is great at responding however; they keep apologizing for typos or things not working correctly by saying they’re actively working on fixing these errors and they underestimated the time it would take to include some things (these are just examples). That’s a problem because, again, you’re being charged over $100 for an app that isn’t even complete or working the way it “should be”. This is $50 dollars more than your average video game, or streaming subscription. It is straight up a rip off and they know it. They push the yearly subscription yet claim they have so much to offer for free, they need to realize that their app is not worth $100.

Also a lot of the reviews on here seem to be bots/falsified. I see more negative reviews than positive ones yet they have 4+ rating. Doesn’t make sense.
reviews.reply:
Thanks for your detailed feedback! 

1. As for having not much to offer, 
We have pretty much content available for free: horoscope for today, week, month, and year; one Compatibility report per day; a few Learning guide lessons; and the first three sessions of relationship guide. Paid subscription opens advanced content: unlimited compatibility reports, relationship guide, and full access to learning guide materials. 

2. As for typos and minor issues, there is so much content in our app, it's difficult to make it typos-free. We appreciate feedback on that and constantly improve content. But it doesn't mean that the app is not complete. 

3. As for pricing, we're trying different pricing options to find the right balance for our users and us. Developing the app takes resources, and we won't be able to do it, if it's not viable from business perspective. 

And remember the quote “If you're not paying for the product, you are the product”, so choose “free” products wisely. 

4. As for ratings, it's not falsified. Most of people leave a rating without a review, people tend to write only negative comments.

 RESPONSE TO YOUR ORIGINAL REPLY BACK: 🙄pathetic. You all are delusional & condescending. reviews.text: This app is a scam and deceptive. They said you are trying a free trial. There is no way to see if you have a subscription in app or on web. I contacted support to cancel they send you a bot to try to talk too. They send you a link to cancel through Apple purchases, but they don’t show the trial at all until they sneakily charge you 45 dollars multiple times. It set off a fraud alert on my card and had to cancel it. I won’t have access to my bank account for over a week now until I get a new card. The customer service I finally did talk to were extremely rude and unhelpful. Saying that by taking any quiz you agreed to a 45 dollar charge and failed to cancel. Again sent me links to cancel, which I had already tried to do on my own the day I downloaded. There was in fact later a message saying I couldn’t cancel until my subscription was active. It wasn’t active until they sneak in the 45 dollar charge. This company is deceptive. I reported them fraudulent. I called Apple to deal with it and they had no proof I signed up for this subscription through Apple Pay. If I could give 0 stars I would. This is absolutely a scam. The “psychic” I messaged to cancel said they are sorry and paid so they have nothing to do with the app. TLDR: BEWARE DO NOT USE THIS APP IT CHARGES YOU FOR EVERYTHING WITHOUT WARNING AND YOU CANNOT CANCEL UNTIL THEY GET MULTIPLE CHARGES OF 45 DOLLARS FROM YOU.

reviews.title: This app is a scam
reviews.text:
First of all, the app is really just about talking to psychics and not much about astrology or spirit animals or any of that like the ads claim. 

Second, the app also makes you answer all these buzz feed quiz style questions and take a picture of your hand for a “palm reading” during the setup phase but never gives you the results of that.

And finally, the biggest scam of all: at the end of all the questions and such, it forces you to pay before you can see the results (that don’t exist). But here’s the kicker: it initially tells you what the actual price is but if you can’t afford that, it gives you other prices you could pay including $1. I chose the $1 option because I couldn’t afford to pay full price nor do I want to before I’ve even seen the results. I ultimately decided the app wasn’t worth it so I deleted it. Well, a few days later I got a notification from my bank about this very app trying to charge me $45. So I blocked the charge and redownloaded the app and had to play around in settings for 10 minutes before I found the “how to check for active subscriptions” button  and entered in my email and discovered that the app had, in fact, signed me up for a subscription that I didn’t want. And it wasn’t even premium! I still had the option to sign up for premium because I didn’t have it. So what the h**l is the $45 for?

reviews.title: DO NOT RISK IT.
reviews.text:
I got this app on a whim three months ago. I used it for one day and realized it was trash, so I unsubscribed and deleted it on my phone, and made sure it was off my subscriptions list on my iPhone (all the things you are supposed to do when cancelling an app). 
Every month since then NEBULA HAS BEEN CHARGING ME. I go online to their main website for support, it is EXTREMELY deluded, there really is no information regarding customer issues or care. So I go to Apple support to report the app and get reimbursement, but because my iPhone and Apple both think this app is and has been unsubscribed and cancelled, I cannot select it for reporting and get reimbursement. I called my bank, luckily they were able to block Nebula for all future payments, but I do still need to file my claim to hopefully get my money back. After dealing with this annoyance for the last couple months I decided to go online and do a little more research on nebula reviews, turns out there are tons of people just like me with shockingly similar stories pertaining to being charged LONG AFTER their nebula subscription was cancelled. 

IMO I wouldn’t risk it, it’s been a hassle to get my 60 bucks back, and to be honest I think if I didn’t notice I was being charged monthly in the first place, AND if I wasn’t putting in the work now to stop Nebula, this would have just kept going on and on. 
This app was made by imbeciles, I don’t think it’s necessarily an intentional scam, but the tech is just so pitiful, a 5 year old could do better. Just save yourself the money and the trouble, there are other silly horoscope apps out there.

There is no one else connected to my account. I ended up moving all the money out of my bank account to avoid these charges. For months I’ve been inspecting every purchase I’ve made to see where it could be coming from. Finally after checking with my computer and cross referencing my phone purchases I see a Nebula weekly subscription charge for $0.00 4 days after the original purchase. Note that this charge does not show up on my iPhone X under purchases or subscriptions. After checking the app, I realized the in-app purchases add up with the random and constant attempts from apple to collect $9.99. As well as stating I am still subscribed to their weekly subscription. This subscription shows up as CANCELLED under my subscription tab and should be CANCELLED. This app is engaging in fraudulent and dishonest activities BEWARE.

I get that it costs money to provide the convenience of this app and the services you host on it but jeez Louise you can’t find out a single freaking thing besides what your birth chart looks like and what your main planets are, literally everything else just teases you with a little snippet of text about it and locks it behind a paywall. I get paying for the readings and psychic services and like having a real person analyze your data but to not even let someone see the basic, established information about their planets and houses without paying is absolutely ridiculous. reviews.title: Money Grab, Not Worth Your Time
reviews.text:
Where do I even start? First, I found this app through an advertisement on Pinterest that advertised a reading for some sort of witch magic type, but only AFTER I spend minutes of valuable time answering each question in the quiz, my actual results were behind a paywall, so I felt like if I didn’t spend a dollar, it was a waste of time. Okay, so I spent the dollar, then it told me I would receive a link to my reading in my gmail. So I downloaded the app, clicked the link in the gmail, and it STILL wouldn’t give me the results of the quiz I paid a dollar for. I WANT MY DOLLAR BACK.

And don’t even get me started on the way the actual app works. The whole thing is just a greedy scam made to cheat you out of your money. They say “three minutes of free readings with three psychics!” But when you run out of credits after what I’m pretty sure was less than three minutes, you only had the chance to talk to one psychic, and then you have to buy more credits for an outrageous 10 dollars for JUST 80 credits. You can’t send messages after that, not even to apologize to the psychics for wasting their time. EVERYTHING on the app costs money. Every single feature. At this point, just buy tarot cards or a book on astrology. You’ll get way more bang for your buck that way.

The personalized birth chart readings were remarkably accurate. It felt like the app had peeked into my soul, revealing aspects of my personality and life path that resonated profoundly. Whether you're a seasoned astrology enthusiast or a curious beginner, Nebula's insights are worth exploring. As with any form of divination, skepticism is healthy. Nebula acknowledges this delicate balance. It doesn't claim to have all the answers, but it encourages introspection. Rather than spoon-feeding predictions, it nudges you to consider possibilities. And that's where the magic lies—when you blend cosmic wisdom with your own discernment. Nebula doesn't promise to change your fate overnight. Instead, it reminds us that we're the architects of our destiny. The planets may influence, but our choices steer the ship. It's like having a celestial GPS—guidance without coercion. So, yes, Nebula offers insights, but it also empowers us to take charge. Beyond the charts and interpretations, Nebula fosters a sense of community. Connecting with like-minded souls, sharing experiences, and learning from one another—it's a cosmic coffee shop where the universe serves wisdom in every cup. In a world where noise often drowns out whispers of the stars, Nebula stands out. It's not about blind faith; it's about embracing the mystery. So, whether you're navigating life's storms or basking in its sunsets, Nebula is a worthy companion—one that encourages growth, reflection, and stargazing.

Then I was questioned about why I supposedly had “a whole bunch of accounts.” I didn’t intentionally create multiple accounts—my original account was deleted, and trying to log back in created another one.

I was also criticized for asking the same or similar questions. Sometimes people repeat a question because they’re desperate for clarity, reassurance, or a better understanding of what they’re going through. That doesn’t mean they should be judged or treated badly.

After my experience, I personally don’t feel like this app is worth spending money on when you’re looking for answers. I’ve spent time on here hoping for genuine guidance, and instead I’ve walked away feeling disappointed and questioning whether the service is trustworthy.

At this point, I would rather go somewhere in person, such as Cassadaga, and speak with someone face-to-face. In my experience there, you don’t necessarily have to keep asking question after question—they can simply tell you what they feel or pick up on.

This is just my personal experience and opinion, but I feel like I wasted my time and money on this app. I expected a much better experience, and unfortunately, I’m leaving very disappointed.

If you like the product and it’s worth $45 a month for you, good for you. This is definitely not worth $45 for me. This is basically a scam. Spend your money on an actual tarot reader. They just want your money and won’t give you a refund even though it’s “money back guarantee” READ THE FINE PRINT. Set an alarm. In this economy, $45 is nothing to play with. Especially since I can go buy a shirt from a store for $45 and if I don’t like it I can return it. I don’t want this product, couldn’t find the cancellation so didn’t know I had a subscription and now they won’t give me a refund because the fine print of their “money back guarentee” is that you actually won’t get your money back. I would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: Waste of time and $$$
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app thinking it would be worth wild, however, I was sadly mistaken. I’m a HUGE astrology enthusiast who has already done most research into my birth chart. After seeing an ad for the app I thought, “WTH why not give it a shot.” When it comes down to it this app has a lot of work to do to not only for convenience but also functionally. 

After downloading the app the first thing that rubbed me wrong was the amount of times I was asked to subscribe (sign-up for a membership). The first time I was prompted I didn’t know it was optional until I noticed the X (close button) in the top right corner. However, after closing the subscription screen I was prompted several more times to subscribe in order to do almost anything on the app. The basic functions of the app are horoscopes and your personal birth chart, which are free. These can pretty much be found on ANY website for free and are just as accurate if not better on other websites.  

Secondly, I noticed that I accidentally put in the wrong birth time. When trying to correct this mistake I realized that there was no way to correct it or at the very least it is very difficult to find.

Overall, in my opinion this app is not worth the time nor amount of $$$ for the features. The only thing I like about this app is the features it has such as the palmistry, however, you need to subscribe for $119 (annual) or 9.99 (monthly) to be able to access many or these features.
reviews.reply:

All the advisors I talk to all seemingly just tell you want you want to hear, you’ll get random advisors that you’ve never even spoken with before sending you messages without even asking when you’ve been using the app or have been actively using it recently and clogs up your notifications, and the best part of it all, this app tried charging my one debit card 5+ times for $45 without my consent!!! I have proof of all of it, plus it wasn’t even the one I used on the app!! It tried charging me on a different debit card I had in my Apple Wallet after I took my active debit card off of it!!! Luckily it kept declining as I turned that one off prior to downloading this app, but I’m very disappointed and would advise others to use caution while using this app.

reviews.title: Be Careful and Cautious with Readings
reviews.text: The website is designed so that your credit card gets automatically charged to extend sessions with psychics. Even after intentionally choosing do not auto replenish, it somehow clicked back on for me. And Nebula does not do refunds. So make sure you don’t fall victim to the traps of the way the website is designed to take your money. It’s a shame Nebula isn’t more transparent with their rules at the time of purchase in live readings and what different links to extend time with psychic really mean. I hope they can find a way to be more transparent. They don’t even show the number of credits you have remaining when you are in session. Unfortunately after emailing with customer service a satisfactory resolution was not able to be met. There is no area in the use profile to see, change, or remove your credit card information not sure if that’s even legal.
reviews.reply:

So I went ahead and requested a refund explaining the situation. Technical problem, no intention to putt chase. And they said NO. Tried to dispute, because it is the truth, and accepted and then declined. Doesn’t seem reasonable or caring for its customers. But not only that. If the app was actually worth the money I would just keep it, but it is worthless. Even the newspaper horoscope, lol, seems better than this. reviews.text:

This app honestly has impressed me because when I downloaded it I assumed it would be like all of the rest of the horoscope apps- mostly just ads and a very brief, short or dull daily reading. But I stand corrected... 
In the past 6 months, without even paying a dime, I’ve been able to get a VERY accurate daily and weekly horoscope reading, hair cut/coloring calendar, beauty tips relating to my zodiac sign, and more all thanks to Nebula. A big thank you to the people who run this app ❤️ blessings to you guys

reviews.title: Garbage - false ad for free cartography report
reviews.text: Prompted by an ad on Instagram, I followed the steps to get a free astro cartography reading. They also had me take a picture of my palm. They had me fill in a bunch of information, and they said that it would be sent to my inbox. I go to my inbox, and it says to access my reading, click here. Each time I do it, it sends me to a download page for an app called Nebula. When I go inside the app, it prompts me a million different ways to sign up and pay for psychic readings. Nowhere in the app does my astro cartography reading show, nor does my palmistry reading show. I just give all of this information to them and they didn't give me what they promised. This seems like a scam and a hoax. They're just trying to get you to get psychic readings so they can bill you per minute and upcharge you. Likely scam. Disappointing. Will be filing a fraud claim with the Apple Store.

reviews.title: Fun to compare zodiacs, but all horoscopes are the same
reviews.text:
It’s got a couple fun little things like adding a friend as a profile, or comparing zodiac signs. The problem is that every horoscope is more or less the same across the signs. There’s probably a three or four word difference in the same sentence of a paragraph as if the writer is in middle school and is “not plagiarizing” their essay. 

Also, the friend I added is a Scorpio-Libra cusp. She’s a Scorpio, but the app said her chart landed her in Libra, and the horoscope connected to her profile is the exact same as mine which is Scorpio. It also has Scorpio and Libra intertwined with each other when viewing planetary placements which is annoying. 

All in all fun little app, but definitely needs some kinks worked out and I definitely want my money back.

reviews.title: Scammy?
reviews.text:
I signed up for this app on my phone from an Instagram ad and it is nice looking and well designed but the $19 subscription that I was somehow signed up for takes away anything good I had to say about the app itself.

I tried to cancel my subscription after the trial and the app said I didn’t have a mobile subscription. I tried canceling the web subscription by entering my email and nothing happened. So I assumed it cancelled my subscription. WRONG! They’ve been charging my card for 5 months. 

When you go to their support page and submit a help request you get an email saying if you can’t cancel your mobile account it probably means you have a web account. Probably?!? I don’t want to delete this app before I get my refund but I’m definitely not recommending anyone else sign up for their “free trial”.

I’ve made a drastic change in my journey and for some reason it’s like the app can’t see that I made this change, and is instead still trying to teach my past self something instead of new me. I feel lost, and when I came to this app for guidance, now I find none. Daily horoscopes feel repetitive and daily tarots feel inaccurate to my current situation. The app is still beautiful starting off with your spiritual journey, however now I feel like I have nothing else to gain from this app and now I need guidance from stronger and smarter individuals.

reviews.text: Fell for an ad on Instagram, thought I was just opting in to pay what I wanted to try the service. reviews.title: Charged me before they said they would & is expensive
reviews.text:
I recall when I signed up I signed up for the 3day trial where they said they’d charge me on the third day and so I went to cancel the subscription a little past midnight worrying they might have charged me already. They did but I didn’t realize they charged me at 9:55AM a whole DAY before they said I’d be charged!! I was able to submit a refund request through Apple so I’m hoping this will end well, but we shall see. 

I know I didn’t buy it on the 16th, because the day I said I’d opt in after downloading it was the 15th in the afternoon (before I took a screenshot at 4pm). The third day, when they said they’d charge me was supposed to be the 17th and even if we go by hours of time I had the app, it wasn’t even a full day. 

Readings and talking to psychics or whatever else they have are a ton of money and are not included in subscription prices. If there are actual psychics working for this app and not AI chatbots (I can’t say if there are real people bc I only got to chat with one over text for 3min which meant I got nothing from the conversation bc I barely had time to ask mine) then I guess it’s nice they get paid, but that and any and all readings that aren’t the basic ones costs money. 

If I could indulge the app enough to test if the calls or texts were AI I’d ask how many of a specific letter was in a word a few times bc AI’s can’t do anything but make a guess at that due to how they process information differently than humans. Just in case anyone needs it. 

Outside of that, if anyone ultra rich wants to spend money on the app I guess it’s really clear and well designed. Wish I could say more but wow that app felt like it wanted to squeeze every penny out of me.

reviews.title: Suggestion
reviews.text:
I have yet to explore the app, because I do not have the option that best suits me in the gender question. I would like to know whether or not that question is about someone’s gender or sex (what the doctor calls out, reproductive organs). 

  Though, even if it was about someone’s sex, you would still be leaving people out, intersex people or hermaphrodites. If it’s about gender And not the sex of someone, I’d suggest simply adding non binary because it’s both a term people identify with and an umbrella term people might use when they don’t fall into the male or female binary.

   If it’s about the sex of someone I’d suggest straight up saying that instead of using gender as the term because they don’t mean the same. And if it is sex the please do add intersex or hermaphrodite, both preferably.

  Until I’m either told what it is directly or until you add those options, I will not be able to go further into the app as I am unwilling to have incorrect pronouns. 

Thank you
   - Someone hoping to use this app because they are very interested in astrology

(Speaking of which [Im not sure if this is a feature] can you add options to change gender or pronouns because not everyone is entirely sure of gender or pronouns)
reviews.reply: Hello! Thanks a lot for your suggestion. We will put maximum efforts to improve our app in order to make it convenient for all users, so please stay tuned.

reviews.title: SCAM!
reviews.text: Do not buy this app! They will charge you one dollar if you want to get your reading, and even if you cancel your subscription, they will try to charge you $50 over and over and over again, regardless of whether or not it is listed in your subscriptions. My account is literally in the “30 day process” of being deleted (I had it for one day), and yet they will not stop trying to charge me. I have checked my Apple subscriptions and it is not listed there. I have used third-party apps that manage subscriptions, and it is not listed there. I am not subscribed and still, they will not stop. Not only this, but in the app, there’s not an option to cancel any supposed subscription you may have in the first place. This app is horrible and I suggest that you do not buy this unless you were looking to be scammed out of $50 continuously.

reviews.reply:
We have about a million of happy users with about 13,000 5-star reviews. 
Unfortunately sometimes the issues like yours happen. We always respond to this issue and do everything possible to help with the issues. If you need any other assistance, please drop us an email at nebula@gen.tech 


As for your question ho to cancel your subscription. Deleting an app doesn't cancel your subscription. 
Please follow this steps to check your subscription status and cancel it, if it's still active: 
Open Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions on your iPhone.

There you will see a list of all active and expired subscriptions. When you tap on a subscription from the list, you can choose a different subscription option or tap Cancel Subscription.

If you don’t see Cancel Subscription, the subscription is already canceled and won't renew. 

Here's a more detailed guide on that from Apple: 
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

reviews.title: Transparency and Trust Needed for a Better Experience.
reviews.text:
As someone who values exploring spirituality and self-discovery, I was initially drawn to this app for its engaging quizzes and intriguing topics. However, my experience left me feeling frustrated and disappointed. While the concept is great, the execution feels deceptive.

The app asks you to pay what you’re comfortable with for readings, which initially builds trust, but then subtly leads into a subscription model with unclear terms. The font for important details, such as auto-renewal, becomes smaller and harder to read. This could easily take advantage of vulnerable users who come to the app seeking clarity and hope. Transparency upfront about pricing and features would go a long way toward earning trust and loyalty.

As a (honestly very new) astrologer, I also found potential inaccuracies in their astrology readings, which further diminished the credibility of the app. The marketing—using catchy Pinterest and Instagram ads like “Are you a witch by blood?”—is appealing, but it feels like a bait-and-switch when users realize they’re being funneled into expensive subscriptions or psychic readings they may not want or need.

I would recommend the app developers offer users a chance to explore more free features before locking content behind payments. Let users enjoy the space to connect with their spiritual side without the constant upselling. This could transform the app into a trusted resource instead of a frustrating experience.

While I appreciate the creative ideas behind the app, it needs to prioritize transparency and genuine support for users over aggressive monetization strategies. I hope they consider these changes, as this could become a truly meaningful platform for those exploring spirituality.

reviews.text:
UPDATE: Not a fan of the fatphobia showing in my horoscopes and such. Telling me to go on diets that are more healthy for me. Diet culture is toxic and causes eating disorders. Please do better Nebula. Leave the diet culture, and implement actual healthy feedback. I already have a bad self body image, try helping us accept our bodies as they are and to remind us that it is good for us to eat. If you are super stuck on keeping healthy food conversation in this, at least talk about keeping a healthy balance of foods, including letting yourself eat junk food sometimes along with healthy food. We deserve to treat ourselves. I honestly wouldn’t include anything diet related in this, except reminding us to eat and not give into diet culture, and not to starve ourselves for a “better body image”. That we are perfect the way we are. ——————
——————
 Okay, so this app gets super honest about all kinds of aspects about yourself, and it may feel really awful when it brings up the bad qualities, and at first I was hesitant to believe it, but this month it has been talking about how I will look at things in different perspectives, and that this month (October 2022) is best for observation, focus, and resolve. I’m trying to look at my negative qualities, and my positive ones. I’m trying to slow down my thinking and how I behave and act. It takes a lot of resolve and insight to work on the negative parts of yourself, and to even accept them, but if you truly want to work on yourself, it can happen, and it can be done in a way that is patient and compassionate towards yourself and other people. This app has really helped me in these areas. I have a hard time listening to my positive qualities too, cause my entire life different people tried to stifle the good parts about me, so I am learning to hear good things about myself without feeling bad about it and actually accepting it. It is really nice how the app talks about how I can be creative and do really great things with my creativity if I put the work into it. People in my life tell me I am great at writing, but I have a hard time actually writing without feeling discouraged. So I am trying to work on that. This app helps me grow and work on myself, and that is something I really appreciate.

reviews.title: Heteronormative Language
reviews.text:
When I first downloaded this app, I really enjoyed its readings, graphics, and breakdowns of my astrological chart.

However, the more frequently I used it, the more likely I was to encounter daily horoscopes that mentioned my “partner of the opposite sex,” and more alienating language that marginalizes populations within the LGBTQ+ community.

I really try not to nit-pick, but this is an important critique to be made. Many users are not heterosexual. Many. To say “opposite sex parter” is incredibly presumptuous and most importantly, inaccurate. Astrology, of course, maybe isn’t intended to be accurate, but there are language options that can avoid this negative outcome. 

I don’t even like the Co-star app, but it makes a point of using gender neutral language or simply saying “partner” and it’s a lot less problematic. 

The language choice on this app is the only reason I deleted it. If it were to change, I’d 100% re-download it and advertise it among my friends that use competing apps.

reviews.title: Scam!!  Run!!! Do not!!
reviews.text:
⚠️ Classic bait-and-switch scam. This app preys on people’s spirituality and emotional vulnerability, luring you in with the promise of a personal reading—but that reading never actually materializes.

I took the time to thoughtfully fill out all the questionnaires. I paid for what was advertised as a “first round” of insight, only to receive nothing in return. Every time I’m prompted to “check my results,” I’m met with yet another upsell, leading down an endless maze of additional payments and empty promises.

This isn’t just poor customer service—it’s predatory marketing. They exploit people who are going through real, difficult life experiences, offering false hope in exchange for money.

I’ve already reported them for fraud, and I want a full cancellation and refund. This operation is disgraceful and unethical, and I am now on a personal mission to warn others about how horrific and fake this organization truly is.

💸 I paid. I downloaded. I trusted. Never again. Consumers deserve better.

reviews.title: Scam-Misleading and false advertisement
reviews.text: Not to mention the customer service department is so out of sync with their customer request cases. I signed up for the 7 day trial, and I also signed up for the 3day love connection trial. I read the love connection info which was basically an explanation of how my boyfriend and I were compatible according to our zodiac signs and it offered advice on how to communicate with each other. I wanted more clarity and a personalized reading so I opted to purchase the love connection reading which is advertised to give an in depth and personalized reading of my relationship. It required me to add additional information about my relationship that I wanted answered in the reading. Since my relationship is long distance, I let the ‘psychic’ know that along with information that I wanted answers too. I wasn’t sure how long the reading would take so I asked customer service for feedback. They sent me an article from their faqs page that stated that the reading would take 3 days. A few hours later I received my reading. First ‘red flag’ that I was not getting what I paid for. To my frustration the reading I received was not only a repeat of the free love connection info I received regarding our zodiac compatibility, but also a 30 day relationship activity calendar telling me what my (long distant) boyfriend and I needed to do to strengthen our relationship. All of which required us to be physically present with each other. I requested a refund to which I was offered a bunch of free services equivalent to my purchase price. I then was told by a completely separate CS rep to contact apple support to receive my refund and assured that I would receive it. Unfortunately I was once again deceived by Nebula, who immediately locked my trials before they expired so I was unable to have access to the information I received free and they refused my refund request with apple support. I now have to file a fraudulent/scam claim with apple support and my bank to recover my funds. Not to mention I continue to receive CS emails from nebula asking me for more info, and even though I repeatedly respond as requested, I am now in a loop of being asked for info and told that my claim has been resolved. Just an overall terrible experience! At very least they could have apologized and offered me the actual reading I paid for with the info offered in their love connection reading description.

reviews.text:

However.
The psychic readings are a total scam. 
20$ for barely 3 minutes of time with a psychic is insane. 
During my 3 minute free trial I received no insight whatsoever. Most of the time was spent typing and the responses from the “psychic” were dry and read suspiciously like an AI bot.

If you want to get an authentic psychic reading please try to find a local psychic who you can speak to in person.
Supporting a local business instead of throwing money at an app is not just the right thing to do, but it’ll also offer more insightful, interactive, and meaningful readings.
reviews.reply:

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback about our app. We're glad to hear that you enjoy the daily horoscope and app interface.

We apologize for your unsatisfactory experience with our psychic readings. We want to clarify that our pricing structure varies for different psychics, and the rates are clearly displayed next to each advisor's profile. Additionally, we offer offline requests with different response times and pricing options for added convenience.

Regarding your specific concerns:

• Prices vary based on the individual advisor's experience and expertise.
• We take the authenticity of our readings seriously. If you felt the responses were not genuine or insightful, we'd like to investigate this further.
• Our free trials are meant to give a brief introduction, but we understand if it didn't meet your expectations.

We value your feedback and would like to address your concerns personally. Please contact us directly at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com. 
We'll be happy to investigate the communication that left you dissatisfied and discuss potential compensation.

While we respect your preference for in-person readings, we strive to provide a convenient and valuable service for those who may not have access to local psychics. We're constantly working to improve our platform based on user feedback.

Thank you again for your honest review. We hope to have the opportunity to improve your experience with our service.

Best regards,
Nebula Support Team 💫️

reviews.title: Neb review
reviews.text:
Nebula is a sleek, easy-to-use astrology app that offers daily horoscopes, birth chart insights, tarot readings, and live psychic chats. It’s great for quick spiritual guidance and can feel very personal and comforting if you enjoy that kind of content.

However, the biggest downside is pricing—many users report surprise charges after low-cost trials and frequent upselling. Some readings can also feel generic rather than deeply personalized.

Overall:
✨ Good for light guidance and vibes
⚠️ Be cautious with subscriptions and spending

👉 Best used as a spiritual tool for reflection—not something to rely on fully for major decisions.
